player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid format; please submit your guess as “[<number>]”.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kuhuhumuna chatela kupwa hakachi ka {min_guess} ni {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
message.round_win: Mutu yoze akwete {winner} kakumba mu chihanda!

outcome.p0_wins: Mutu yoze te akulinga yiteli 0 yapwile ni kuheta yikuma yinji.
outcome.p1_wins: Mutu yoze te akulinga yiteli 1 yapwa ni uhashi wa kuheta yikuma yinji.
